description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

No-training 12-layer circuit (no LayerNorm): attention gathers the 10 input digits, ReLU AND-gates build digit-pair products into column sums, 3 rounds of exact floor/carry-save reduction, then carry lookahead over runs of 9s and a position-gated one-hot digit readout.

Same 12-layer circuit as MulCircuitGatherCarryLookahead, but a_i is gathered as a scalar value and multiplied by one-hot b_j via gates relu(a_i + 10*[b_j=y] - 10) = a_i*[b_j=y]; the pair-product layer shrinks from 2025 to 225 units.

9-layer circuit: scalar-a pair-product gates, then each carry-save round (floor(x/10) thresholds + pass-through + next-column carry) fused into a single MLP layer; carry lookahead over 9-runs and a position-gated one-hot digit readout.
Same 9-layer fused-round circuit as MulCircuitFusedRounds, with attention sharpness BETA reduced from 300 to 30 to test how soft the gather attention can be while still exact.
Same 9-layer fused-round circuit as MulCircuitFusedRounds, with attention sharpness BETA set to 60 (between the failing 30 and passing 100) to bracket the sharpness threshold.
Same 9-layer fused-round circuit as MulCircuitFusedRounds, with attention sharpness BETA set to 45 (between the failing 30 and passing 60) to bracket the sharpness threshold.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: carry-in looks only at the immediately lower column (drops the run-of-9s propagation of the carry lookahead) to test whether it is needed.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: the readout ignores the answer position and always emits the MSD column, to test that each answer step must select its own digit.
Same 9-layer fused-round circuit as MulCircuitFusedRounds, with attention sharpness BETA set to 50 (between the failing 45 and passing 60) to refine the sharpness threshold.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: carry-in lookahead removed (CIN=0), so each column keeps only its own carry-save value; measures how much accuracy depends on carries.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: round 1 of the carry-save reduction keeps only the within-column value and drops the carry-out to the next column (tests round-1 carries).
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: round 2 of the carry-save reduction drops the carry-out to the next column (tests round-2 carries).
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: round 3 of the carry-save reduction drops the carry-out to the next column (tests round-3 carries).
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: the carry lookahead loses its generate term (a column of 10 no longer creates a carry; only runs of 9s are kept, so EQ=0).
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: the carry-save rounds drop the pass-through of the column value itself, keeping only the floor/carry terms (tests that the units digit is carried).
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds with BETA=0: gather attention is uniform over the prefix instead of sharply selecting the input digits; tests that the sharp gather is essential.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: partial products are placed at column i+j instead of 8-(i+j), i.e. the place values of a and b are reversed; tests the column-index convention.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: the round-1 floor thresholds only go up to 20, so column sums of 210 or more are misrepresented; tests that the full 0..405 range is needed.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=60: the position gate reads column 8-k instead of 9-k (off-by-one digit selection); tests the alignment between answer step and output column.
Same 9-layer fused-round circuit as MulCircuitFusedRounds, with attention sharpness BETA set to 55 to refine the sharpness threshold between 50 and 60.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=55: the digit readout does not subtract the carry-out (z = D3 + CIN without the -10*COUT term), so columns that carry emit an out-of-range digit.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=55: the carry-in lookahead only scans the two columns directly below (a 10 or a 9-run longer than one column is ignored); tests how far carries propagate.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=55: each digit-pair gate outputs (y+1) instead of y, a wrong multiplication table; tests that the partial products are computed exactly.
Same 9-layer fused-round circuit as MulCircuitFusedRounds, with attention sharpness BETA raised to 1000 to check that very sharp gather attention remains exact.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=1000: the round-2 floor thresholds only go up to 30, so round-1 values of 40 or more are misread; tests the range of the second carry-save round.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=1000: the third carry-save round is removed (D3 = 0), so the carry lookahead sees no column values; tests that round 3 is required.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=1000: the digit-pair gates use bias -9 instead of -10, so an unselected gate leaks a_i+1 for b_j != y; tests the exactness of the AND-gate threshold.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=1000: the round-1 floor thresholds only go up to 35, so column sums of 360 or more are misrepresented; tests the upper end of the sum range.
Ablation of MulCircuitFusedRounds at BETA=1000: the carry-in lookahead only scans the three columns directly below; tests how far a carry must propagate through runs of 9s.
Same 9-layer fused-round circuit as MulCircuitFusedRounds, with attention sharpness BETA reduced from 300 to 100 to find the sharpness threshold for exact gathering.
